category_title: Kindergarten students involved in physical conflict over classroom space
scenario_title: Physical conflict over seating during transition to morning meeting
minimal_context: Aiden and Ariel are transitioning to the morning meeting rug at the start of the school day.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Aiden, I saw you walk up and push Ariel. What is going on?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Aiden makes eye contact) I want him to move. That’s my spot.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you use your words to ask him that, to ask him to move somewhere different?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Aiden looks to the floor, knotting his fingers and kicking the ground) Can you move to another spot? That’s my spot. (Ariel kicks the ground as well and tucks both hands beneath his waistband.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Did it bother you, Ariel, that Aiden touched you? Did it bother you when he pushed you instead of using words?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Ariel stares, expressionless. He continues staring, and eventually whispers) I’m sorry that you bothered me.
